individual_items.name: Painted left glove
individual_items.evaluation: Broad smooth coral mitten, right-facing authored thumb, gold shell and coral cuff retain a single readable contour. Matte painted bands, purple ink and aqua/lavender shadow fit the toy storybook stage. Complete-canvas texture is drawn intact with the existing position/depth/angle. The first left attempt with finger lobes remains rejected.

individual_items.name: Painted right glove
individual_items.evaluation: The independently generated left-facing thumb and teal cuff distinguish the right hand while keeping the same coral mitten palette and matte material. Positive scale avoids accidentally reversing its authored hand. Whole painted contour survives contact, return and corner requests.

individual_items.name: Exact existing clean puff
individual_items.evaluation: Existing rounded white/lavender painted cloud removes the stray dark marks. The whole card expands modestly and alpha tends continuously to zero; every inspected final has no residual cloud. This rating evaluates effect artwork and fading only; the belt still lacks a rendered glove-contact beat.

priorities.item: Imp connected reaction and recovery acting
priorities.evaluation: Source keys preserve the friendly identity, but sudden complete-pose substitutions do not explain anticipation, body contact and recovery. Preserve all approved identity sources; evaluate authored bridge states against exact action timing.

The accepted completion resets the glove to rest before the contact frame is rendered. Preserve cancellation on interruption; separate successful completion presentation from the interruption reset, then measure real contact/return and the parent transition.
